video_title: Damian Lillard Media Availability | Oct. 19, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on Portland's need to improve rebounding and ball security
quotes.excerpt: I think defensive rebounding and taking care of the ball.
quotes.quote: I think defensive rebounding and taking care of the ball. With the kind of talent we have offensively, I think we should be trying to get a shot up every time down. Obviously, turnovers are going to happen, but I think we turn over the ball too many times. Looking at our preseason games, and then the defensive rebounding. In this league, if you give teams two and three opportunities, it's going to be hard to come up with a stop in the end. I think we get teams to miss, we just got to come up with the ball that first time and try to limit giving them extra opportunities.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says the Blazers need to clean up their defensive rebounding and ball security to succeed this season. He noted that giving teams two or three opportunities per possession makes it hard to get stops.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the importance of team rebounding for the guards
quotes.excerpt: Obviously with us being kind of undersized, it's going to be a group effort.
quotes.quote: Obviously with us being kind of undersized, it's going to be a group effort and us as guards, we got to obviously DC and Rob and those guys are going to have their hands full trying to keep those big guys off, but in a league where they shoot a lot of threes now, we got to know it's going to be long rebounds. We're going to have to chase down rebounds and like I said, it's going to be a group effort, so we're definitely going to have to pull our weight in that way.
quotes.social_post: With the Blazers playing smaller, Damian Lillard says rebounding will be a group effort. He emphasized that guards need to help chase down long rebounds in a league where teams are shooting more threes.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard praises the team's offensive sets and execution
quotes.excerpt: I think our ATOs have been great. I told Mike that.
quotes.quote: I think our ATOs have been great. I told Mike that. I think we've executed them well, but I think he's drawn up some some great stuff. I think they have layers. Each step of the play has it's an option. There's no wasted cuts, there's no wasted time. It's like everything is an option and if you take this away, then this should be open. If you take that away, then this should be open.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard is impressed with the team's offensive sets under Mike, noting that the plays have layers and options for everyone on the floor. He says there are no wasted cuts in their current system.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the evolution of ATO plays and team creativity
quotes.excerpt: Back in the day when we used to play the Clippers, we used to be like, they're going to run the ATO for JJ Redick.
quotes.quote: Back in the day when we used to play the Clippers, we used to be like, they're going to run the ATO for JJ Redick, like you knew that. And his style and the plays that we've been running throughout the preseason, it's like I'm going to have an opportunity, but it's going to be after I set a screen and that guy could be open at the rim. If they help on me, it's going to be another guy diving. It's just a lot of layers to the ATOs that we run.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says the Blazers' new offensive sets are designed to create opportunities for everyone. He explained that even when he sets a screen, the play is designed to keep the defense guessing with multiple options.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on his mindset returning to regular season play
quotes.excerpt: I don't feel emotional about it at all.
quotes.quote: I don't feel emotional about it at all. I'm excited. I think when you spent that much time away and not being able to play, you're excited to be back. Excited to play meaningful basketball, games that count. Coming back into the preseason, I was excited to to play again, too, after all that time. It was more emotional when I first signed back to play here. I was like, man, that was what I wanted to see happen and it did. And that was the emotional part of it.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says he is excited to return to meaningful basketball after his time away. He admits the emotional part of his return was signing back with the team, but he is now focused on the season ahead.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on enjoying playing off the ball with the guard group
quotes.quote: To me it's a luxury. In the preseason, I think I played right at 20 minutes one game, then maybe 23 minutes another game, 25 another game, and I didn't walk away from any of those games feeling like taxed or achy at all. Some people might say it's preseason, but after being out for a year, you would think it would be hard to recover and I think a lot of that is because I'm not having to work so hard to bring the ball up, to create advantages, to beat so many people.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says playing off the ball is a luxury that has helped him feel fresh during the preseason. He noted that not having to work as hard to bring the ball up has made a noticeable difference in his recovery.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the versatility of small-ball lineups
quotes.excerpt: You're going to see a lot of small ball around the NBA.
quotes.quote: You're going to see a lot of small ball around the NBA. You're going to see teams playing smaller because they want to play with pace. It's harder for a big lineup to get up and down the floor the way that teams want to get up and down the floor now. So going that way, I think we're going to be a little more versatile. You're going to be able to switch a lot of things, you're going to have multiple ball-handlers out there, multiple guys that can get into the paint and make that next play.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard believes the Blazers will be more versatile this year by leaning into small ball. He says the ability to switch and have multiple ball handlers on the floor will help the team play with more pace.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on the team's commitment to sacrifice for winning
quotes.excerpt: One thing I respect a lot about Mica is we don't have to guess.
quotes.quote: One thing I respect a lot about Mica is we don't have to guess or wonder what it is. He's been right direct about it and up front and not just to us in private, it's said in front of the whole team. So I think that's been a really good thing to have from your coach. But we've talked about sacrifice and doing what we have to do for the team to win and that's really it. We know that we're all going to have to give up something and we got to be willing to do that if we really want to win.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says the Blazers are embracing a culture of sacrifice to win. He praised coach Mike for being direct with the team about what is required from every player to reach their goals.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on managing his workload at age 36
quotes.excerpt: I know I'm 36 and we've had conversations about I'm not going to be playing 38 minutes per night.
quotes.quote: I know I'm 36 and we've had conversations about I'm not going to be playing 38 minutes per night. I'm sure there'll be games where I play more extended minutes and some higher minutes, but with the depth that we have, specifically at the guard position, I don't think I'll be having to play super high minutes. I'm a live body. I've taken care of myself for years and years and years, on and off the floor, and I don't want it to be misunderstood like I'm not an old man. I want to be responsible and take care of myself because of how many years I have played and the wear and tear, the miles, they add up.
quotes.social_post: Damian Lillard says he does not expect to play 38 minutes per night at age 36. He noted that the team's depth at guard will allow him to manage his workload and stay fresh throughout the season.
